message.content: In one of the conversations, Jasper mentions participating in a soccer practice session on Saturday afternoon, stating "Saturday afternoon works great for me. I could also use some practice on my shooting. Where do you want to meet?" Farrah also confirms this plan, saying "3 PM at the local park sounds perfect! I’ll bring a ball and some cones too. This should be a great way to improve our shooting skills while having a blast!" Therefore, they plan to meet at 3 PM on Saturday afternoon for the soccer practice session.
